scripts.start: bash -lc 'export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; command -v nvm >/dev/null 2>&1 && nvm use || true; export NODE_BINARY="$(command -v node)"; react-native start "$@"' --
scripts.android: bash -lc 'export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; command -v nvm >/dev/null 2>&1 && nvm use || true; export NODE_BINARY="$(command -v node)"; GRADLE_USER_HOME="$PWD/.gradle" react-native run-android "$@"' --
scripts.android:no-packager: bash -lc 'export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; command -v nvm >/dev/null 2>&1 && nvm use || true; export NODE_BINARY="$(command -v node)"; GRADLE_USER_HOME="$PWD/.gradle" react-native run-android --no-packager "$@"' --
scripts.android:release: bash -lc 'export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; command -v nvm >/dev/null 2>&1 && nvm use || true; export NODE_BINARY="$(command -v node)"; cd android && GRADLE_USER_HOME=../.gradle ./gradlew installRelease "$@"' --
scripts.android:release:apk: bash -lc 'export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; command -v nvm >/dev/null 2>&1 && nvm use || true; export NODE_BINARY="$(command -v node)"; cd android && GRADLE_USER_HOME=../.gradle ./gradlew assembleRelease "$@"' --
